2609.09363.title: Do LLMs Make More Mistakes If They Do Not Believe the Input Data?
2609.09363.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) are prone to hallucinating or misinterpreting facts, which impairs their usability in retrieval-augmented generation or data-to-text systems. We analyse how faithfulness of LLMs to provided context depends on how plausible they perceive the context to be (context-memory conflict). To better identify error patterns, we make use of the increased difficulty of non-English and low-resource language text generation and input data based on local knowledge, only partially captured in models' parametric knowledge. We let the models generate text in English, Czech, Slovak and Upper Sorbian from factual (FA), counterfactual (CFA) and fictional (FI) RDF triples containing local Czech and Slovak data. Contrary to our expectations, we observe only a weak context-memory conflict on the human-annotated sample. For Kimi K3 as an LLM judge, which agrees well with human annotations on the sample, counterfactual inputs receive only slightly lower faithfulness scores than factual ones (-0.05 on a 1-5 scale). We also find that a suboptimal choice of LLM judge would lead to overestimating the strength of the context-memory conflict.
2609.09363.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）容易出現幻覺或誤解事實，這影響了它們在檢索增強生成或數據到文本系統中的可用性。<lb/>我們分析了LLMs對提供的上下文的忠實度如何取決於它們對該上下文的可行性認知（上下文-記憶衝突）。<lb/>為了更好地識別錯誤模式，我們利用了非英語和低資源語言文本生成的難度增加，以及基於地方知識的輸入數據，這些知識在模型的參數知識中僅部分捕捉到。<lb/>我們讓模型從包含當地捷克和斯洛伐克數據的事實（FA）、反事實（CFA）和虛構（FI）RDF三元組中生成英文、捷克文、斯洛伐克文和上索賓文的文本。<lb/>與我們的預期相反，我們在人工標註的樣本中僅觀察到弱的上下文-記憶衝突。<lb/>對於Kimi K3作為LLM評判者，其與樣本中的人類標註一致，反事實輸入的忠實度分數僅比事實輸入低稍微一點（在1-5的量表上為-0.05）。<lb/>我們還發現，次優的LLM評判者選擇會導致對上下文-記憶衝突強度的高估。
2609.09363.author: Peter Kochelka et.al.
